title: Med-REFL: Enhancing Complex Medical Reasoning via Fine-grained Self-Correction

bias_targets.methodology: Conducting controlled stress tests on medical reasoning datasets using intrinsic and adversarial diagnostic subsets to measure 'Reflection Divergence Rate' and 'Correction Success Rate', assessing whether the model genuinely self-corrects or merely exhibits 'fake reflection' by reaffirming its initial flawed reasoning.
